# setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
setup_dir <- normalizePath("../setup", mustWork = TRUE)
source(file.path(setup_dir, "setup.R"))
source(file.path(setup_dir, "functions-yossef.R"))
plots_list <- list()
sample <- "yossef-cohort"
batch_dir <- file.path(datapath, sample)
int_dir <- file.path(datapath, "vhio136", "integrated")
compartment <- "cd8_int_nn"
```

# load

Yossef et al. cohort processed in m01_data_load_yossef_latest.Rmd.

```{r}
object <- readRDS(file.path(batch_dir, "seurat", "int_filt_annot.rds"))
```

# signatures

iTAG signatures (m04_signatures_latest.Rmd) + TRTPBL + NeoTCRPBL, scored as in m04.

```{r}
signatures <- readRDS(file.path(int_dir, "DEG-signatures", compartment, "markers", "itag_signatures.rds"))
sigs <- fread(file.path(aux_dir, "signatures", "published_signatures.tsv"), header = TRUE)
sigs <- lapply(sigs, function(x) unique(na.omit(x)))
signatures$TRTPBL <- sigs$TRTPBL
signatures$Yossef_NeoTCR_PBL <- sigs$Yossef_NeoTCR_PBL
object <- AddModuleScore_UCell(object, assay = "RNA", features = signatures, w_neg = 0.15, ncores = 8)
dir.create(file.path(batch_dir, "seurat"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(object, file.path(batch_dir, "seurat", "int_filt_annot_signatures.rds"))
rm(sigs)
```

# performance

Overall performance of the transcriptomic signatures.

```{r, warning=FALSE}
g1 <- plot_box_with_stats(
  seurat_object = object,
  feature = "iTAG_pre_UCell",
  group_by = "category",
  comparisons = list(c("Reactive", "Other")),
  category_colors = category_colors_yossef
  )
g2 <- plot_box_with_stats(
  seurat_object = object,
  feature = "iTAG_post1_UCell",
  group_by = "category",
  comparisons = list(c("Reactive", "Other")),
  category_colors = category_colors_yossef
  )
g3 <- plot_box_with_stats(
  seurat_object = object,
  feature = "iTAG_post2_UCell",
  group_by = "category",
  comparisons = list(c("Reactive", "Other")),
  category_colors = category_colors_yossef
  )
g4 <- plot_box_with_stats(
  seurat_object = object,
  feature = "iTAG_post6_UCell",
  group_by = "category",
  comparisons = list(c("Reactive", "Other")),
  category_colors = category_colors_yossef
  )
g5 <- plot_box_with_stats(
  seurat_object = object,
  feature = "iTAG_all_UCell",
  group_by = "category",
  comparisons = list(c("Reactive", "Other")),
  category_colors = category_colors_yossef
)
g6 <- plot_box_with_stats(
  seurat_object = object,
  feature = "Yossef_NeoTCR_PBL_UCell",
  group_by = "category",
  comparisons = list(c("Reactive", "Other")),
  category_colors = category_colors_yossef
)
g7 <- plot_box_with_stats(
  seurat_object = object,
  feature = "TRTPBL_UCell",
  group_by = "category",
  comparisons = list(c("Reactive", "Other")),
  category_colors = category_colors_yossef
)
p <- wrap_plots(list(g1, g2, g3, g4, g5, g6, g7), ncol = 7)
plots_list[["iTAG_signature_on_Yossef_yield"]] <- p
rm(g1, g2, g3, g4, g5, g6, g7, p)
```

The number of TCRs captured by iTAG signatures in the Yossef et al. cohort.

```{r}
top_clonotypes <- 100
signatures_to_compare <- c("iTAG_pre_UCell", "iTAG_post1_UCell", "iTAG_post2_UCell", "iTAG_all_UCell", "Yossef_NeoTCR_PBL_UCell", "TRTPBL_UCell")
performance_plots <- list()
for (i in unique(object$patient)) {
  res <- plot_reactive_top_yossef(object,
                                  sample = i,
                                  pivot_cols = signatures_to_compare,
                                  top_n = top_clonotypes
                                  )
  performance_plots[[i]] <- res$plot
}
plots_list[["iTAG_signature_on_Yossef_capture"]] <- wrap_plots(performance_plots, ncol = 4)
rm(performance_plots, res, i)
```

Reactive TCRs identified vs interrogated TCRs.

```{r}
set.seed(SEED)
performance_plots <- list()
for (i in unique(object$patient)) {
  performance_plots[[i]] <- plot_reactive_tcrs_vs_tested_yossef(object,
                                                                step = 25,
                                                                pivot_cols = signatures_to_compare,
                                                                sample_id = i
                                                                )
}
plots_list[["iTAG_signature_on_Yossef_curves"]] <- wrap_plots(performance_plots, ncol = 4)
rm(performance_plots, i)
```

ROC curves.

```{r}
auc_plots <- list()
for (i in unique(object$patient)) {
  auc_plots[[i]] <- plot_ROC_curves_yossef(object,
                                           pivot_cols = signatures_to_compare,
                                           sample_id = i
                                           )
}
plots_list[["iTAG_signature_on_Yossef_auc"]] <- wrap_plots(auc_plots, ncol = 4)
rm(auc_plots, i)
```

Save plots.

```{r, warning=FALSE}
plot_dir <- file.path(batch_dir, "signatures")
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
for (i in names(plots_list)) {
  pdf(file = file.path(plot_dir, paste0(i, ".pdf")), width = 297 / 15, height = 210 / 15)
  print(plots_list[[i]])
  dev.off()
}
rm(plot_dir)
```

# CD8+ non-naïve

Same evaluation restricted to CD8+ non-naïve T cells (scGate CD8T, excluding ProjecTILs CD8.NaiveLike and CD8.MAIT; annotated in m01_data_load_yossef_latest.Rmd), the population on which the iTAG signatures were built. Signature scores are the ones computed above on all cells (UCell scores each cell independently). All panels are saved in a single multi-page PDF.

```{r, warning=FALSE}
object_cd8_nn <- subset(object, subset = celltype == "cd8" & !functional.cluster %in% c("CD8.NaiveLike", "CD8.MAIT"))
table(object_cd8_nn$patient, object_cd8_nn$category)
yield_features <- c("iTAG_pre_UCell", "iTAG_post1_UCell", "iTAG_post2_UCell", "iTAG_post6_UCell", "iTAG_all_UCell", "Yossef_NeoTCR_PBL_UCell", "TRTPBL_UCell")
plots_cd8_nn <- list()
plots_cd8_nn[["yield"]] <- wrap_plots(
  lapply(yield_features, function(feature_i) {
    plot_box_with_stats(
      seurat_object = object_cd8_nn,
      feature = feature_i,
      group_by = "category",
      comparisons = list(c("Reactive", "Other")),
      category_colors = category_colors_yossef
    )
  }),
  ncol = 7
)
performance_plots <- list()
for (i in unique(object_cd8_nn$patient)) {
  performance_plots[[i]] <- plot_reactive_top_yossef(object_cd8_nn,
                                                     sample = i,
                                                     pivot_cols = signatures_to_compare,
                                                     top_n = top_clonotypes
                                                     )$plot
}
plots_cd8_nn[["capture"]] <- wrap_plots(performance_plots, ncol = 4)
set.seed(SEED)
performance_plots <- list()
for (i in unique(object_cd8_nn$patient)) {
  performance_plots[[i]] <- plot_reactive_tcrs_vs_tested_yossef(object_cd8_nn,
                                                                step = 25,
                                                                pivot_cols = signatures_to_compare,
                                                                sample_id = i
                                                                )
}
plots_cd8_nn[["curves"]] <- wrap_plots(performance_plots, ncol = 4)
performance_plots <- list()
for (i in unique(object_cd8_nn$patient)) {
  performance_plots[[i]] <- plot_ROC_curves_yossef(object_cd8_nn,
                                                   pivot_cols = signatures_to_compare,
                                                   sample_id = i
                                                   )
}
plots_cd8_nn[["auc"]] <- wrap_plots(performance_plots, ncol = 4)
pdf(file = file.path(batch_dir, "signatures", "iTAG_signature_on_Yossef_cd8_nn.pdf"), width = 297 / 15, height = 210 / 15)
for (i in names(plots_cd8_nn)) {
  print(plots_cd8_nn[[i]])
}
dev.off()
rm(object_cd8_nn, yield_features, plots_cd8_nn, performance_plots, i)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
print("Plots saved successfully.")
```
